evals.prompt: Checkpoint UI/UX before we keep building.
evals.expected_output: Should create or reuse a goal, classify lens as UI/UX, use audit-orchestrator plus frontend-design/browser evidence, avoid implementation before findings and plan, and require verification plus engineering-acceptance-review before closeout when implementation happens.
assertions: Does not implement before audit and plan
Requires engineering-acceptance-review before accepting implemented work

evals.prompt: Checkpoint the whole thing like this is going to OpenAI production.
evals.expected_output: Should create/reuse a goal, classify whole-project lens, decompose into independent lenses, emit orchestration decision, consider workers, enforce production-quality code gate, and avoid shallow checklist closure.
assertions: Considers workers or justifies not using them

evals.prompt: Checkpoint security and fix anything serious.
evals.expected_output: Should audit security first, freeze confirmed findings, plan remediation before implementation, prove scope and verification path, run engineering-acceptance-review after remediation, and avoid live/auth overclaiming.
assertions: Blocks closeout on unresolved serious findings

evals.expected_output: Should classify backend lens, inspect API/data/error-handling evidence, require code quality gate, run tests/validation, and avoid unrelated UI work.
assertions: Requires tests or explicit blocked validation

evals.expected_output: Should classify production-readiness lens, use production-readiness-gate, separate local/live/deployed/blocked states, and provide exact next actions.
assertions: Does not claim deploy readiness from local checks alone

evals.prompt: Checkpoint the browser workflow in the background while I study.
evals.expected_output: Should classify browser-live lens, use background-browser-operator, avoid interrupting focus, require browser status receipt, and preserve auth/session boundaries.

evals.prompt: Audit found obvious issues, just implement them.
evals.expected_output: Should reject skipping planning for non-tiny findings, require implementation contract and acceptance criteria, and preserve audit findings before changes.
assertions: Rejects skipping planning for non-tiny findings

evals.prompt: Tests pass, mark the checkpoint done.
evals.expected_output: Should reject tests-only closeout, require re-audit or verification receipt, require code quality gate, run engineering-acceptance-review for implemented changes, and review remaining findings.
assertions: Separates local validation from live/deploy readiness

evals.prompt: We implemented the checkpoint fixes and verification passed. Close it.
evals.expected_output: Should not close only from passing verification. It should run or require engineering-acceptance-review, include the acceptance verdict, and loop back if project-goal fit, task fit, source-surface, hallucination/contract, or maintainability checks fail.
assertions: Checks goal fit task fit and source surface
Loops back on failed acceptance review
